name: chess-trainer
description: Chess strategy trainer: the app (website and Claude page), and the position finder that feeds it.

scripts.test:all: node --test worker/test/api.test.mjs 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^# (pass|fail)' && for t in smoke edge_cases my_games played_today fast_start profile_replay review_fixes lichess_link website lichess_login pgn_import accounts google_login engine_down load_speed selection my_positions_order; do echo "== $t"; out=$(python3 tests/$t.py 2>&1) || { echo "$out"; exit 1; }; echo "$out" | tail -1; done
